detail.longDescription: I'm looking for a DNS hosting service, ideally free, to act as a secondary NS. I'm currently using deSEC, which I'm currently happy with. I'm finding out that free services fail short to provide DNSSEC multi signer support (among other things). Any free (or cheap) service like deSEC that I can use as a secondary NS? Thanks in advance! Edit: ideally hosted by an European individual/company #AskFedi #FediHelp #DevOps
